```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(htmltools)
library(scales)

recent_df <- read_csv("data/processed/recent_vehicles_2022_2027.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
img_df <- read_csv("data/processed/vehicle_images.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

n_recent <- nrow(recent_df)
sweet_df <- recent_df |>
  filter(!is.na(horsepower_combined), !is.na(annual_fuel_cost), !is.na(powertrain))
n_sweet <- nrow(sweet_df)
```

## Featured Rides (MY 2024–2027)

```{r}
#| label: build-gallery-data
#| include: false

featured_specs <- img_df |>
  pmap(\(make, model_prefix, local_image, commons_file, source_url, photographer, license, license_url) {
    recent_df |>
      filter(
        .data$make == .env$make,
        str_detect(model, fixed(model_prefix, ignore_case = TRUE)),
        !is.na(mpg_combined)
      ) |>
      arrange(is.na(horsepower_combined), desc(year)) |>
      slice_head(n = 1) |>
      bind_cols(tibble(
        local_image = local_image,
        source_url = source_url,
        photographer = photographer,
        license = license,
        license_url = license_url
      ))
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

render_vehicle_cards <- function(df) {
  cards <- pmap(df, function(...) {
    row <- list(...)
    eff_unit <- if (identical(row$powertrain, "Electric")) "MPGe" else "MPG"
    hp_val <- if (!is.na(row$horsepower_combined)) paste0(comma(row$horsepower_combined), " hp") else "EV / Hybrid"
    cost_val <- if (!is.na(row$annual_fuel_cost)) paste0(dollar(row$annual_fuel_cost), "/yr") else "—"
    range_badge <- if (identical(row$powertrain, "Electric") && !is.na(row$electric_range) && row$electric_range > 0) {
      tags$span(
        style = "background:#d90429; color:#fff; font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:700; padding:0.15rem 0.5rem; border-radius:999px; margin-left:0.35rem;",
        paste0(row$electric_range, " mi range")
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }

    div(
      style = "background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #deded9; border-top:4px solid #d90429; box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(17,17,17,0.08); display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between;",
      div(
        tags$img(
          src = row$local_image,
          alt = paste(row$year, row$make, row$model),
          style = "width:100%; height:175px; object-fit:cover; border-bottom:1px solid #ecece8;"
        ),
        div(
          style = "padding:0.75rem 0.9rem;",
          div(
            style = "margin-bottom:0.35rem;",
            tags$span(
              style = "background:#111111; color:#ffffff; font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:700; padding:0.15rem 0.5rem; border-radius:999px;",
              row$powertrain
            ),
            range_badge
          ),
          tags$h4(
            style = "margin:0.2rem 0 0.55rem 0; font-size:1rem; font-weight:800; color:#111111;",
            paste(row$year, row$make, row$model)
          ),
          div(
            style = "display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); gap:0.35rem; background:#f7f7f5; padding:0.45rem; border-radius:0.35rem; text-align:center; font-size:0.78rem;",
            div(tags$div(style = "color:#666; font-size:0.68rem;", "POWER"), tags$strong(hp_val)),
            div(tags$div(style = "color:#666; font-size:0.68rem;", eff_unit), tags$strong(paste0(row$mpg_city, "/", row$mpg_highway))),
            div(tags$div(style = "color:#666; font-size:0.68rem;", "ENERGY"), tags$strong(cost_val))
          )
        )
      ),
      div(
        style = "background:#fafafa; border-top:1px solid #eeeeee; padding:0.4rem 0.9rem; font-size:0.7rem; color:#666;",
        "Photo: ", row$photographer, " · ",
        tags$a(href = row$license_url, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", row$license),
        " · ",
        tags$a(href = row$source_url, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", "Source")
      )
    )
  })

  div(
    style = "display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(255px, 1fr)); gap:1rem; margin:0.75rem 0;",
    cards
  )
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### All (`r nrow(featured_specs)`)

```{r}
#| label: gallery-all
#| echo: false
render_vehicle_cards(featured_specs)
```

### Electric (`r sum(featured_specs$powertrain == "Electric")`)

```{r}
#| label: gallery-ev
#| echo: false
render_vehicle_cards(featured_specs |> filter(powertrain == "Electric"))
```

### Gas (`r sum(featured_specs$powertrain == "Gas")`)

```{r}
#| label: gallery-gas
#| echo: false
render_vehicle_cards(featured_specs |> filter(powertrain == "Gas"))
```

### Hybrid & Plug-In (`r sum(featured_specs$powertrain %in% c("Hybrid", "Plug-in Hybrid"))`)

```{r}
#| label: gallery-hybrid
#| echo: false
render_vehicle_cards(featured_specs |> filter(powertrain %in% c("Hybrid", "Plug-in Hybrid")))
```

:::

## Sweet-Spot Finder: Power vs. Annual Fuel Cost (`N = `r comma(n_sweet)``)

Hover or zoom into the **bottom-right corner** to spot high-horsepower cars with ultra-low annual running costs (`MY 2022–2027`).

::: {.plot-container}
```{r}
#| label: fig-sweet-spot

sweet_plot_df <- sweet_df |>
  mutate(
    hover_text = paste0(
      "<b>", year, " ", make, " ", model, "</b><br>",
      powertrain, " · ", body_group, "<br>",
      "Horsepower: ", comma(horsepower_combined), " hp<br>",
      "Annual Cost: ", dollar(annual_fuel_cost), "/yr<br>",
      "Combined: ", mpg_combined, if_else(powertrain == "Electric", " MPGe", " MPG")
    )
  )

p_sweet <- ggplot(
  sweet_plot_df,
  aes(x = horsepower_combined, y = annual_fuel_cost, color = powertrain, text = hover_text)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_number(suffix = " hp")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_dollar(suffix = "/yr")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Electric" = "#d90429",
    "Hybrid" = "#ef233c",
    "Plug-in Hybrid" = "#ff758f",
    "Gas" = "#202020",
    "Diesel" = "#7a7a7a"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Horsepower vs. Estimated Annual Energy Cost (N = ", comma(n_sweet), " Recent Trims)"),
    x = "Horsepower (hp)",
    y = "EPA Annual Fuel / Electricity Cost",
    color = "Powertrain"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggplotly(p_sweet, tooltip = "text", height = 410) |>
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.18),
    margin = list(t = 42, r = 20, b = 70, l = 65)
  ) |>
  config(responsive = TRUE)
```
:::

## Search All `r comma(n_recent)` Trims (MY 2022–2027)

```{=html}
<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.45rem; align-items:center; margin:0.5rem 0 0.75rem;">
  <span style="font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:700; color:#111;">Quick Jump:</span>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onclick="quickFilterCar('Electric')">⚡ Electric</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-dark" onclick="quickFilterCar('Hybrid')">🌱 Hybrid</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-dark" onclick="quickFilterCar('Porsche')">🏎️ Porsche</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-dark" onclick="quickFilterCar('Lucid')">🔋 Lucid</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-dark" onclick="quickFilterCar('Rivian')">🛻 Rivian</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-dark" onclick="quickFilterCar('Corvette')">🏁 Corvette</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="quickFilterCar('')">↺ Reset</button>
</div>
<script>
function quickFilterCar(term) {
  const input = document.querySelector('.dataTables_filter input');
  if (input) {
    input.value = term;
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event('keyup', { bubbles: true }));
  }
}
</script>
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-car-explorer

explorer_table <- recent_df |>
  mutate(ev_range_only = if_else(powertrain == "Electric", electric_range, NA_real_)) |>
  select(
    Year = year,
    Make = make,
    Model = model,
    Trim = trim,
    Style = body_group,
    Powertrain = powertrain,
    HP = horsepower_combined,
    City = mpg_city,
    Hwy = mpg_highway,
    `EV Mi` = ev_range_only,
    `$/Yr` = annual_fuel_cost
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Make = as.factor(Make),
    Style = as.factor(Style),
    Powertrain = as.factor(Powertrain)
  )

datatable(
  explorer_table,
  filter = "top",
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 12,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE
  )
) |>
  formatCurrency("$/Yr", currency = "$", digits = 0) |>
  formatRound(c("HP", "City", "Hwy", "EV Mi"), digits = 0)
```
